UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'.
Use dark colors independently without simplistic gradients. DO NOT use generic purple/violet gradients on white.
NO centered-equal-spacing generic cards. Create depth with z-index hierarchy and overlapping.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (backdrop-blur-xl).
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions.
DO NOT center align the app container. Respect natural reading flow.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use expo/vector-icons (@expo/vector-icons ionicons/feather set).
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, tap scales, parallax).
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, and halftone patterns separate good from extraordinary.
Use test IDs on all interactive elements via data-testid.
You have .js files not .tsx files, so write all React components using standard .js and PropTypes if needed.
Strict Dark Mode ONLY. No light mode fallbacks.

headings.usage: Display headings, chapter titles, choice text, SFX comic lettering.

body.usage: Chat reader text, body paragraphs, button labels.

visual_enhancers.art_style: Webtoon originals meets Spider-Verse comic style. Bold clean ink outlines, cel shading, halftone.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #2A2A38 for most surfaces. Panels use thicker dynamic borders.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl combined with surface colors at 70% opacity.
visual_enhancers.overlays: Never use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays. Minimum background should be rgba(10, 10, 15, 0.85).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard offset shadows (comic book style) rather than soft blur shadows.

ChatReader.layout: Immersive full-screen. No bottom nav. Top-edge tap-to-exit bar (height: 48px). Chapter title bar at top.

ChoiceMoment.backdrop: Dimmed background at 80% opacity (#0A0A0F) with backdrop-blur-sm.
ChoiceMoment.cards: Glassmorphic comic-panel style. 1px border. Hover/Press scales down slightly.
ChoiceMoment.premium_treatment: 1px gold (#FFC94A) border, gold gradient background, gem cost badge top right, tiny helper line under option text ('Unlock special scene').

animations.choice_appear: Slide up and fade in from bottom, staggered by 100ms.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize the READER screen and AVATAR BUILDER as hero surfaces.
Implement the 'delulu is the solulu' brand heavily via the copy objects provided.
Ensure the avatar layer z-index system is strictly maintained using absolute positioning.
Implement all micro-interactions using framer-motion or React Native Reanimated equivalent.
Use expo-haptics extensively linked to user choices and gem purchases.
Enforce dark mode strictly. There is no light mode fallback.
All components should use 'data-testid' for QA testing.
